title: Claim idle timeout is too aggressive — lapses mid build-and-test and hands the device to another agent
description: Observed 2026-09-06 on mac-studio with several agents sharing devices. simemu's claim idle timeout is roughly 30-60s, far shorter than a build-and-test cycle. A lane claimed a device, ran xcodebuild, and by the time it took a screenshot the claim had lapsed and another agent's FitKind run held the device — so it captured the wrong app in the foreground and correctly distrusted its own evidence. Two problems: (1) the timeout is measured against simemu interactions rather than the claim holder still being alive, so a long build looks idle; (2) a lapse is silent — nothing tells the holder it lost the device, and raw simctl calls then land on someone else's session. A claim should survive as long as its holder lives, and losing one should be loud.
